subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these privileged GitHub Action revision changes after a workflow/security owner verifies the upstream contracts and final-head runs?
rationale: The patch changes external code executed with GitHub App private keys, package-publishing credentials, and OpenAI agent credentials; whether those upstream revisions are acceptable cannot be resolved safely from Dependabot metadata alone.

options.title: Verify then merge
options.body: Review the changed action contracts and attach redacted successful workflow evidence for the final head before accepting the pinned revisions.

options.title: Hold for curated updates
options.body: Pause this grouped update and land only individually reviewed action upgrades through the repository's normal dependency-maintenance path.

recommendation.title: Verify then merge
recommendation.body: Review the changed action contracts and attach redacted successful workflow evidence for the final head before accepting the pinned revisions.

likelyOwner.reason: A concrete workflow/security owner was not identifiable from the supplied history evidence.
